Hi Elena — great to meet you. Attaching our AP onboarding packet and a sample invoice template. High level answers below:  

- Required PO fields we will echo back on the invoice: PO Number (required), PO Line/Item (if provided), PO Quantity, Unit Price, PO Delivery Date. If you provide a project code we will include it in the "Project/Cost Center" field on the invoice.
- Tax identifiers: for US invoices we can provide W9; for EU customers we provide VAT self-cert + VAT registration number if applicable. Attached: "US_W9_or_VAT_Self_Cert.pdf".
- Remit address: we support electronic payments (ACH / wire) and can include an EFT remit block on the invoice. Physical remit addresses can also be included if your system requires it.
- Invoice reference format: Invoice: RW-<cust-short>-YYYYMMDD-####; we will populate your PO number and PO line into the invoice reference.
- Payment terms: Default Net 30. We are open to an early-pay discount (1.5% for Net 10) for enterprise customers; I can confirm with finance for the specific Atlas account if you'd like.

Two operational notes: 1) If your portal issues a vendor token or vendor id, please share it and we'll update our records immediately. 2) If you require any special GL/charge class mapping, send a sample PO export and we will map at invoicing.

Attaching: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf, redwood_sample_invoice_template.xlsx, US_W9_or_VAT_Self_Cert.pdf

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
